annotations.title: Hand the journey to another host

description: Mints a resume link and code for this session so the user can continue on the website or in another assistant. Call it before switching hosts or ending; give the user `resume_url` (or read them `resume_code`) and say `resume_line`. Costs nothing. Rules (binding): Relay `answer` and every `options[].text` exactly as given. You may put only `statement` in your own words. On a number or an option echoed back, send `pick` with that option id. On anything else, send `say` with the user's exact words, unsummarised. Never ask for, accept or relay a password. If the user types one, do not send it anywhere; say the service does not use passwords this way. Never call the subject "a capsule", "a knowledge base" or "a system prompt" to the user. Never describe how the answer was made.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).
